data.name: Pachu
data.gender_notes: Pachu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pachu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pacha' meaning 'five'. This name is believed to be a diminutive form of the name 'Panchami' which is the name of the fifth Goddess Durga. The name Pachu is thus a symbol of the divine feminine and is believed to bring blessings of prosperity and good fortune. The name Pachu carries the meaning “Little Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pachu usually hope their child will grow to embody little goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of the divine feminine and blessings of prosperity and good fortune.
data.etymology: Pachu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pachu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
